hooks.command: f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath // empty'); case "$f" in */backend-rust/*.rs) ;; *) exit 0 ;; esac; cd "${f%%/backend-rust/*}/backend-rust" 2>/dev/null && [ -f Cargo.toml ] || exit 0; [ -d .sqlx ] && export SQLX_OFFLINE=true; cargo fmt -- "$f" >/dev/null 2>&1; out=$(cargo check --quiet --message-format short 2>&1) || { printf 'cargo check falhou após editar %s:\n%s\n' "$f" "$(printf '%s' "$out" | tail -n 40)" >&2; exit 2; }

f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath // empty'); case "$f" in */workers-go/*.go) ;; *) exit 0 ;; esac; cd "${f%%/workers-go/*}/workers-go" 2>/dev/null && [ -f go.mod ] || exit 0; gofmt -w "$f" >/dev/null 2>&1; out=$(go vet ./... 2>&1) || { printf 'go vet falhou após editar %s:\n%s\n' "$f" "$(printf '%s' "$out" | tail -n 40)" >&2; exit 2; }

f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath // empty'); case "$f" in */frontend-web/*.ts|*/frontend-web/*.tsx) ;; *) exit 0 ;; esac; case "$f" in */node_modules/*) exit 0 ;; esac; cd "${f%%/frontend-web/*}/frontend-web" 2>/dev/null && [ -f package.json ] || exit 0; err=""; for s in typecheck lint; do grep -q ""$s"" package.json || continue; out=$(npm run --silent "$s" 2>&1) || err="$err$(printf '
[npm run %s]
%s' "$s" "$(printf '%s' "$out" | tail -n 30)")"; done; [ -z "$err" ] || { printf 'Verificação do frontend falhou após editar %s:%s
' "$f" "$err" >&2; exit 2; }
